manage:all: Do anything on the server, with no limits.
read:public_content: View any record on the server, whether or not it is public.
manage:household_member:administer: Manage the members of any household, as server staff.
delete:household:administer: Delete any household, as server staff.
update:household:restore:administer: Restore any deleted household, as server staff.
delete:game_play_session:moderate: Delete any play, as a moderator.
read:user:profile:friends: View the profile of a friend, if they let friends see it.
read:user:profile:friends-of-friends: View the profile of a friend of a friend, if they let friends of friends see it.
read:user:profile:extended-network: View the profile of someone in your extended network, if they let their extended network see it.
read:user:profile:public: View profiles that anyone can see.
read:user:searchable: Find users who have made themselves searchable, and see their username, first name and last name.
read:friendships:own: View your friendships and friend requests.
update:friendship:own: Respond to or withdraw a friend request, or block someone, in a friendship you are part of.
delete:friendship:own: Remove a friendship you are part of.
create:upstream_account:own: Link an upstream account of yours, such as your BoardGameGeek username.
read:upstream_account:own: View your own upstream accounts, such as a linked BoardGameGeek username.
delete:upstream_account:own: Unlink one of your upstream accounts.
read:event:friends: View the events of a friend that friends can see.
read:event:friends-of-friends: View the events of a friend of a friend that friends of friends can see.
read:event:extended-network: View events from people in your extended network, if the event reaches that far.
read:event:public: View events that anyone can see.
read:households:friends: View the households of a friend that friends can see.
read:game:friends: View the games of a friend that friends can see.
read:game:friends-of-friends: View the games of a friend of a friend that friends of friends can see.
read:game:extended-network: View games from people in your extended network, if the game reaches that far.
read:game:shared: View the games shared with you, or with a household you belong to.
read:job: View the progress of every game import on the server.
create:game_share: Share a game you created with another user.
read:game_share:own: View the shares of the games you created.
delete:game_share: Remove a game share that you made.
create:game_share:household: Share a game you created with a household you own or administer.
create:game_share:household:member-direc: Share a game you created with your household, when the household lets its members share directly.
create:game_share:household:member-appro: Share a game you created with your household for a household owner or admin to approve, when the household requires that.
read:game_share:household: View the game shares of a household you own or administer.
update:game_share:approve: Approve a member's game share to a household you own or administer.
delete:game_share:household: Remove a game share from a household you own or administer.
read:platform_game: View the platform entries of any game, such as its entry for PC.
read:platform_game:public: View the platform entries of games that anyone can see.
create:platform_game: Add a platform entry to a game, as an import does.
update:platform_game: Edit a game's platform entry, such as the play modes it supports.
read:platform: View the platforms that games are available on.
read:event_occurrence: View the dates of an event you attend.
read:event_occurrence:household: View the dates of your household's events.
read:event_occurrence:friends: View the dates of the events of a friend that friends can see.
read:event_occurrence:friends-of-friends: View the dates of the events of a friend of a friend that friends of friends can see.
read:event_occurrence:extended-network: View the dates of events from people in your extended network, if the event reaches that far.
read:event_occurrence:public: View the dates of events that anyone can see.
create:event_occurrence: Add dates to an event you help run.
create:event_occurrence:household: Add dates to your household's events.
update:event_occurrence: Edit the label, time, venue and order of the dates of an event you help run.
update:event_occurrence:household: Edit the label, time, venue and order of the dates of your household's events.
delete:event_occurrence: Remove a date from an event you help run.
update:event_occurrence:confirm: Confirm a proposed date of an event you help run.
update:event_occurrence:confirm:househol: Confirm a proposed date of your household's events.
update:event_occurrence:decline: Decline a proposed date of an event you help run.
update:event_occurrence:decline:househol: Decline a proposed date of your household's events.
update:event_occurrence:cancel: Cancel a confirmed date of an event you help run.
update:event_occurrence:cancel:household: Cancel a confirmed date of your household's events.
read:event_availability_vote: View the availability votes, and their summary, for an event you attend.
read:event_availability_vote:household: View the availability votes for your household's events.
create:event_availability_vote: Submit or change your availability vote on a proposed date of an event you attend.
read:event_attendee: View the attendees of an event you attend.
read:event_attendee:household: View the attendees of your household's events.
update:event_attendee:status:self: Change your own RSVP, and the notes with it, for an event you attend.
update:event_attendee:status: Change the RSVP of any attendee of an event you help run.
read:event_game_nomination: View the game nominations for an event you attend.
read:event_game_nomination:household: View the game nominations for your household's events.
create:event_game_nomination: Nominate a game for an event you attend.
update:event_game_nomination:withdraw: Withdraw a game nomination that you made.
update:event_game_nomination:resolve: Resolve a game nomination of an event you help run by counting its votes.
update:event_game_nomination:resolve:hou: Resolve a game nomination of your household's events by counting its votes.
update:event_game_nomination:approve: Approve a game nomination for an event you help run, when the event needs the host to approve nominations.
update:event_game_nomination:reject: Reject a game nomination for an event you help run, when the event needs the host to approve nominations.
read:event_game_vote: View the votes on the game nominations of an event you attend.
read:event_game_vote:household: View the votes on the game nominations of your household's events.
create:event_game_vote: Cast or change your vote on a game nomination for an event you attend.
read:event_game: View the lineup of games for an event you attend.
read:event_game:household: View the lineup of games for your household's events.
create:event_game: Add a game directly to the lineup of an event you help run.
create:event_game:household: Add a game directly to the lineup of your household's events.
delete:event_game: Remove a game from the lineup of an event you help run.
delete:event_game:household: Remove a game from the lineup of your household's events.
read:attendee_game_list: View the games that attendees offer to bring to an event you attend.
read:attendee_game_list:household: View the games that attendees offer to bring to your household's events.
create:attendee_game_list: Add a game to the games you offer to bring to an event you attend.
delete:attendee_game_list: Remove a game from the games you offer to bring to an event you attend.
manage:attendee_game_list: Manage the games that any attendee offers to bring to an event you help run.
manage:attendee_game_list:household: Manage the games that any attendee offers to bring to your household's events.
read:event_policy: View the policy of an event you attend, such as who may invite and how games are chosen.
read:event_policy:household: View the policy of your household's events, such as who may invite and how games are chosen.
read:event_policy:friends: View the policy of the events of a friend that friends can see.
read:event_policy:friends-of-friends: View the policy of the events of a friend of a friend that friends of friends can see.
read:event_policy:extended-network: View the policy of events from people in your extended network, if the event reaches that far.
read:event_policy:public: View the policy of events that anyone can see.
update:event_policy: Edit the policy of an event you help run.
update:event_policy:household: Edit the policy of your household's events.
read:game_collection:household: View the collections that your household's members share with it.
read:game_collection:friends: View the collection of a friend that friends can see.
read:game_collection:friends-of-friends: View the collection of a friend of a friend that friends of friends can see.
read:game_collection:extended-network: View collections from people in your extended network, if the collection reaches that far.
read:game_collection:public: View collections that anyone can see.
create:game_collection: Add a game to your collection.
update:game_collection: Edit a game in your collection.
delete:game_collection: Remove a game from your collection.
read:list:friends: View the lists of a friend that friends can see.
read:list:friends-of-friends: View the lists of a friend of a friend that friends of friends can see.
read:list:extended-network: View lists from people in your extended network, if the list reaches that far.
read:list:public: View lists that anyone can see.
update:list: Edit your lists and the entries in them.
read:data_gateway: View the DataGateways added to the server, such as BoardGameGeek and IGDB.
create:data_gateway: Add a DataGateway to the server.
update:data_gateway: Edit a DataGateway that the server uses.
delete:data_gateway: Delete a DataGateway from the server.
read:data_gateway:search: Ask the DataGateways for games when you search, or for a base game's expansions.
read:households: View the households you belong to.
read:household: View the details of a household you belong to.
update:household: Edit a household you own or administer.
update:household:restore: Restore a deleted household you own, within its restore window.
manage:household_member: Manage the members of a household you own, including their household roles and removal.
manage:household_member:as-admin: Change the household role of, or remove, the members and guests of a household you administer.
read:household_member: View the roster of a household you belong to.
read:household_member:friends: View the roster of a friend's household that friends can see.
delete:household_member:leave: Leave a household you belong to.
read:household_ban: View the bans from a household you own or administer.
create:household_ban: Ban someone from a household you own or administer.
update:household_ban: Change the reason for a ban from a household you own or administer.
delete:household_ban: Lift a ban from a household you own or administer.
update:household_role:transfer-ownership: Transfer ownership of a household you own to another member.
create:household_invite: Invite someone to a household you own.
create:household_invite:as-admin: Invite someone to a household you administer, as a member or guest.
create:household_invite:member-direct: Invite someone to your household as a member or guest, when the household lets its members invite directly.
create:household_invite:member-approval: Invite someone to your household as a member or guest, for a household owner or admin to approve, when the household requires that.
read:household_invite: View the invites of a household you own or administer.
update:household_invite:revoke: Revoke an invite that someone else sent to a household you own.
update:household_invite:revoke:as-admin: Revoke an invite that someone else sent to a household you administer, if it offers the member or guest role.
update:household_invite:approve: Approve a member's invite to a household you own or administer.
create:event: Create an event that belongs to no household.
create:event:household: Create an event in your household.
read:event: View every event on the server, whoever it reaches.
update:event: Edit the details of an event you help run, such as its title, description, venue and reach.
update:event:household: Edit the details of your household's events, such as their title, description, venue and reach.
delete:event:moderate: Delete any event on the server, as a moderator.
update:event:cancel: Cancel or reopen an event you host or co-host.
update:event:cancel:household: Cancel or reopen your household's events.
update:event:archive: Archive or unarchive an event you host or co-host.
create:event_invite: Invite people to an event you attend as a participant or help run.
create:event_invite:household: Invite people to your household's events.
manage:event_attendee: Manage the attendees of an event you help run.
manage:event_attendee:household: Manage the attendees of your household's events.
create:event_attendee:attending-role: Add attendees to an event you help run, in a role that attends the event rather than helps run it.
delete:event_attendee:attending-role: Remove attendees from an event you help run, when their role attends the event rather than helps run it.
create:play_record: Record the results of a play at an event you attend.
create:play_record:household: Record the results of your household's plays.
create:game_play_session: Record a play at an event you attend.
create:game_play_session:household: Record a play for your household.
update:game_play_session: Edit a play at an event you attend.
delete:game_play_session: Delete a play at an event you help run.
create:session_player:join: Join any play as a player.
create:session_player:observer:join: Join a play at an event you attend, as an observer.
update:rule_variant: Edit the house rules you created.
delete:rule_variant: Delete the house rules you created.
create:media:upload: Upload an image, video or document for an event you attend.
create:media_object: Upload media, such as an image, video or document.
read:media_object:public: View media that anyone can see.
update:media_object:own: Edit your own media, including publishing, unpublishing, attaching and detaching it.
create:media_contribution: Contribute your own media to a game or event.
update:media_contribution:reclaim: Take back a contribution of yours that was rejected, while its reclaim window lasts.
read:media_contribution: View every media contribution, so it can be reviewed.
create:user_game_customization: Create a game customization, such as a private title or image for a game.
create:feedback_report: Send a feedback report, such as a bug report or a feature request.
read:feedback_report:own: View the feedback reports you sent.
read:feedback_report: View every feedback report that anyone sent.
delete:feedback_report: Permanently delete a feedback report, outside its normal retention.
manage:feedback_report: Do anything with feedback reports, including viewing, changing and deleting any of them.
read:feedback_sink_dispatch: View the record of which sinks each feedback report was forwarded to.
read:safe_http_policy: View the outbound HTTP policy, which limits which outside addresses the server may contact.
manage:safe_http_policy: Change the outbound HTTP policy, including timeouts, redirect limits, strict mode, and which addresses are allowed or blocked.
update:system_setting: Change server-wide settings, such as sign-ups, password resets and feedback redaction.
manage:privacy_policy: Replace the server's privacy policy, in any language.
manage:plugin: Install, update and uninstall plugins on the server, and decide for the whole server which permissions they may use.
read:plugin: View the plugins installed on the server, with their plugin manifests, staged updates and the server's consent decisions.
read:plugin:installed: See which plugins are installed, so you can decide whether to use them yourself or for your households.
manage:plugin:household: Switch plugins on or off, set them up and give consent to them for a household you own or administer, which lets outside code act there.
read:plugin:household: View the plugins switched on for a household you own or administer, with their features and consent status.
manage:webhook_subscription:own: Create, change and delete your own webhook subscriptions.
update:notification:own: Mark your own notifications as read.
manage:quota: Create, change and remove any quota on the server.
read:quota: View every quota on the server.
read:quota:household: View the quotas that apply to a household you own or administer and to each of its members.
manage:quota:household_member: Set the quotas of the members of a household you own or administer.
